_comment: Single source of truth for the pinned npm CI bootstrap identity. The trusted installer scripts/ci/install-npm-pinned.mjs downloads this EXACT url (bounded redirects restricted to canonical_hosts), verifies sha256 over the downloaded bytes BEFORE any install, then installs the verified LOCAL tarball with the existing npm using -g --ignore-scripts --offline. The digest here is validated against nix/npm-12-0-2.nix (its sha256-<base64> SRI decodes to the same hex) by tests/supply_chain/test_npm_bootstrap.py, so version+url+digest have one authority.
